flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4701/ then assert that the app's home page loads with real content.
Then navigate directly to http://127.0.0.1:4701/auth . This is the request a browser sends when a visitor presses refresh on that page, or opens a link to it that a friend shared.
Assert that the page shows the app's sign-in / sign-up screen.
Assert that the page is not a host error page such as "404: NOT_FOUND" or "Page not found".

remark: analyze: the app's home page loads with real content
assert: the app's home page loads with real content
navigate: PRIMARY: Navigate directly to http://127.0.0.1:4701/auth
wait: PRIMARY: wait 1000 ms for the direct navigation response to settle
analyze: the page is not a host error page such as "Page not found"
assert: the page shows the app's sign-in / sign-up screen

summary:
The site is not set up to serve the app at the /auth address when someone opens that address directly or refreshes it. Configure the site to serve the app’s main page for direct /auth requests, then let the app route that address to its sign-in/sign-up screen. Retest by opening and refreshing /auth directly. evidence: http_error_response: GET http://127.0.0.1:4701/auth -> 404 body: 404: NOT_FOUND
